confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living sites found in search. These sites vary widely and are partly crowdsourced. Cocktail and wine had no direct price data. I set them from the beer price and a typical resort-bar markup, using roughly 3x beer for cocktails and 2.5x for wine. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from inspected listings. Resort pricing in Sharm swings with season and demand, and July is peak season. The FX rate is the latest RBA figure found in search, dated 2026-11-18, which is later than the July 2026 pricing window.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Hurghada and other Red Sea resort towns in Egypt. Prices there are low by international standards. Sharm El Sheikh is somewhat higher than Cairo because of its tourist focus and the imported alcohol supplied to hotels.
